conventions.convention: The scalar benchmark uses dimensionless space and time, period 2π, wave speed 1, N ≥ 3, h = 2π/N, k > 0, and exact real arithmetic. Grid indices wrap modulo N.
Initialization is u¹ = u⁰ + kv⁰ + (k²/2)D_hu⁰; subsequent updates are uⁿ⁺¹ = 2uⁿ − uⁿ⁻¹ + k²D_huⁿ. The output includes levels 0 through n_max, with n_max ≥ 1.

The distinct unit-modulus root claim assumes 0 < k/h < 1 and excludes the constant mode. The mean is ū⁰ + nkv̄⁰. At k/h = 1 on an even grid, Nyquist velocity produces the separately stated repeated-root solution.
Use K(X,Y) = g(∇_Xn,Y), ρ = T(n,n), and j_i = −T(n,∂_i). The discrete momentum residual includes +κj_j; the Hamiltonian residual subtracts 2Λ + 2κρ.

Diagnostic coordinates are dimensionless torus angles; h_ij has units m² and K_ij units m. Derivative maps are specified linear array maps annihilating constants. Reconstruction need not be continuous, and residuals alone certify no continuum solution.

The aliasing example uses even N ≥ 4, 0 < ε < 1, L_* > 0, centered periodic derivatives, piecewise-constant reconstruction, uniform positive weights, and a singleton mesh hierarchy. Countable Choice is retained for the supplier's embedded interpretation.

load_bearing.statement: For real periodic arrays u⁰,v⁰ on N ≥ 3 sites, k > 0 and integer n_max ≥ 1, initialize u¹ = u⁰ + kv⁰ + (k²/2)D_hu⁰, update uⁿ⁺¹ = 2uⁿ − uⁿ⁻¹ + k²D_huⁿ for n = 1,…,n_max−1, and output all levels through uⁿ_max using exact real arithmetic.

For the specified positive-definite metric samples, symmetric K samples, matter samples, constants and linear derivative maps annihilating constants, define the displayed discrete connection and curvature arrays and residuals H_Δ = R_Δ + τ_Δ² − |K|_Δ² − 2Λ − 2κρ and M_Δ,j = hⁱᵏ(D_i^ΔK)_kj − δ_jτ_Δ + κj_j. Record the reconstruction, norm, weights, mesh hierarchy, units and boundary treatment.
For N ≥ 3, h = 2π/N, k > 0 and 0 < λ = k/h < 1, each nonconstant discrete Fourier mode has c_ℓ = 1 − 2λ²sin²(πℓ/N) ∈ (−1,1) and distinct roots c_ℓ ± i√(1−c_ℓ²), both of modulus 1.

For every admissible integer N ≥ 3, time-step count n_max ≥ 1, real step k > 0, and pair of real periodic input arrays, the algorithm terminates after exactly n_max−1 update passes and outputs all levels through uⁿ_max. In the stated unit-cost exact-real-arithmetic model, its operation count is O(Nn_max).
